name: Structural biology Agent offline policy gateway fixture
purpose: Defensive teaching fixture: deterministic mock authorization decisions; not a complete Agent.

generated_evidence.audit_examples.json: Allowlisted audit events plus synthetic structured redaction example

trusted_control_plane: RunScope principal_id/tenant_id and capability sets are synthetic trusted-backend labels, never self-reported model fields; they do not implement identity verification.
ApprovalAuthority simulates a trusted approval issuer and protected store; digest itself does not authorize
execution_boundary: No report writes or exports: ALLOW is mock permit only
Only temporary fixture directories/files/symlinks and evidence files are created
limitations: Not production authentication, credential service, multi-tenant isolation or OS sandbox
Same-process untrusted Python can bypass or mutate this fixture
In-memory locking does not implement durable or cross-worker atomic quota/approval consumption
resolve checks have a TOCTOU boundary; no filesystem executor is provided
Policy decisions do not establish scientific correctness
Synthetic structured redaction is not general secret detection or DLP
Units are fixed teaching costs, not measured money or GPU usage
self_hash_note: Manifest intentionally excludes its own hash and temporary __pycache__ files.
staging_note: Download ZIP and installed-file manifest links become available after install_policy_lab.py; source HTML is packaged without post-install mutation.
